info.title: Coinroost
info.description: Personal finance for one household: accounts, transactions, imports.

post.summary: Opens an account. Its currency must be the profile's, when it has one.

409.description: The name or namespace is taken

post.summary:
Imports a bank file into an account, with the account's profile. Transactions already in the account are
skipped; rows that cannot be read are reported and left out.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account the file belongs to

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: The file's name, as the bank gave it.

201.description: What was added and what was skipped

422.description: The file cannot be read with the account's profile
The name is empty or too long

get.summary: Up to when each account has data, what its imported files cover and where the holes are.

parameters.name: today
parameters.description: The caller's date; the server's UTC date when absent.

get.summary: Whether the server and its database answer. Needs no session.

200.description: The server and its database answer

post.summary:
Shows what importing a bank file would do, without importing it: the account it belongs to (found from the
file unless named), every transaction read and whether the account already has it, and the rows that cannot
be read.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: The file's name, as the bank gave it.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The account to read the file for; when absent, the account is found from the file.

422.description: The file cannot be read with the account's profile

get.summary: The user and household of the current session.

422.description: The name is empty or too long

get.summary: What each employer owes at a date: one report per employer, or the reason it has none.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The day to measure at (today in UTC when absent): send the person's today.

get.summary: The bank export formats the server can read, by name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many per currency (default 10, at most 100).

422.description: The period or the limit is not valid

get.summary: The household's rules, first one first.

latest.description: The date of its latest transaction, imported or not.

ranges.description: What the imported files cover, oldest first; files less than 16 days apart count as one range.

AccountMatch.description: How the preview chose the account.

payee_from_text.description: The matched text is a payment channel: the payee is the name that follows it in the description.

BankFile.description: A bank export, byte for byte as the bank gave it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the statements it reads.

items.description: Per currency, most spent first; ties by category id, uncategorized last.
Per currency, most spent first; ties by payee id, no payee last.

CategoryKind.description: What a category holds: spending, income, or money moved between the household's own accounts.

description_contains.description: Text the description contains, compared in upper case; kept exactly as written, spaces included.

oneOf.description: `out` when the amount is below zero, `in` otherwise.

amount_min.description: Magnitude in minor units, both ends included.

items.description: Every account, the most behind first.

Detection.description:
How the account's exports are recognized when several files are dropped at once. A file belongs to the
account when its header has every detection text of the profile and every marker, and, when a label or a
number hash is set, at least one of them. Cards that share a format are told apart by card prefix.

markers.description: Texts the header must also contain, such as the account name as the bank prints it.

card_prefixes.description: Card network prefixes (ISO/IEC 7812), such as `4` for Visa or `34` and `37` for American Express.

label.description: The account type as the bank prints it in the header.

number_hash.description: First 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the account number printed in the header.

amount_minor.description: What a fortnight is worth today.

start.description: The first day of the first fortnight the employer pays.

error.description:
When the deposits could not be read (no deposit counted since `start`), why; the other fields then stay
empty.

unknown.description: Due after the last data of the account.

paid.description: Deposits that counted as a fortnight's pay.

data_until.description: The date "owed" is measured at: `as_of`, or the account's last data when earlier.

history.description: From the first fortnight to the last one due or paid.

days.description: Days late (zero or below: on time); for an owed fortnight, days due at the last data.

oneOf.description: The fortnight the bank's description named, when it named one.

FortnightView.description: A salary fortnight: the 1st to the 15th (half 1) or the 16th to the end of the month (half 2).

Gap.description: Days with no imported file between two imported ranges.

rows_read.description: Data rows in the file, the header excluded.

first_date.description: The first and last date among the rows read, duplicates included; empty when no row could be read.

candidates.description: The accounts the file fits, when it fits several.

oneOf.description: Empty until the account is known.

row_errors.description: Rows that could not be read; they were not imported.

external_id.description: The deduplication key of an imported leg.

code.description: The 6-digit code the authenticator app shows now.

months.description: Months with money in or out, oldest first; then by currency.

namespace.description: Lower case letters, digits, `_` and `-`; cannot change once the account has transactions.

profile.description: Id of the bank profile its exports are read with (`GET /api/v1/profiles` lists them).

amount_minor.description: Signed minor units in the account's currency: negative is money leaving the account.

posted_on.description: The bank's date for this leg; the transaction's date when absent.

position.description: Where it goes, 1 being first; last when absent.

token.description: Also set as the `coinroost_session` cookie; clients without cookies send it as a bearer token.

legs.description: One leg, or two for a transfer.

PairRequest.description: Two one-leg transactions a person says are the same movement.

transaction_id.description: The transfer: the outflow's transaction, now with both legs.

amount_minor.description: Signed minor units in the account's currency: negative is money leaving the account.

duplicate.description: The account already has it: the import skips it.

Problem.description: An error response. `title` is fixed per status; `detail` says what to fix, without internals.

type.description: Always `about:blank`: the status code says it all.

Reading.description: What importing the file into the account would do.

rows.description: The transactions read, in file order.

row_errors.description: Rows that cannot be read; the import leaves them out.

rows_read.description: Data rows in the file, the header excluded.

first_date.description: The first and last date among the rows read, duplicates included.

Reason.description: Why a leg is not paired.

row.description: Row number in the file, 1 being the header.

changes.description: Every transaction applying the rules would change, oldest first.

tag.description: The same tag as the `ETag` header: send it back in `If-Match` to apply.

RuleUpdate.description: The fields to change; the others stay.

position.description: Moves the rule there; the rules in between shift by one.

SetBy.description: Who set a category or a payee.

Sorting.description: A transaction's category and payee, and the rule that set them.

new_payee.description: A payee read from the text that the household does not have yet; applying creates it.

transaction_ids.description: The transfer's transaction, now with the outflow leg only, then the new one with the inflow leg.

totals.description: One entry per currency with money in the period.

Totals.description: Totals in one currency, as positive minor units.

spending.description: Money out of one-leg transactions whose category is not a transfer (uncategorized included).

income.description: Money in of one-leg transactions whose category is not a transfer.

unpaired_transfer_out.description: Money out of transfer legs not paired yet.

unpaired_transfer_in.description: Money in of transfer legs not paired yet.

rule_id.description: The rule that set the category or payee, while it exists.

TransactionUpdate.description: The fields to change; the others stay. What a person sets here, rules never change.

category_id.description: A category; `null` leaves the transaction without one, and rules may sort it again.

payee_id.description: A payee; `null` leaves the transaction without one, and rules may name it again.

TransferLeg.description: One leg that may be half of a transfer, with its transaction.

amount_minor.description: Signed minor units in `currency`: below zero the money left `account_id`.

pass.description: 1: the only match within two days; 2: the outflow's text names the account; 3: Friday to Monday.

drops_manual.description: Pairing drops a category or payee a person chose for the inflow, so imports leave it for you.

pairs.description: The pairs applying would make, oldest first.

tag.description: The same tag as the `ETag` header: send it back in `If-Match` to apply.

candidates.description:
Unpaired legs that could be its other side: same amount, other sign, other account, same currency (any
date when the reason is `no_counterpart`).
